attribution: Informação geográfica cedida pela Direção-Geral do Território
acquisitionNote: 2025 national orthophotography. Parish falls in Lote 3; published lot acquisition range 26 April to 15 July 2025; exact photo dates at individual locations not established.
method: WMS 1.3.0 RGB GetMap in native EPSG:3763. Native source blocks 1024 m square, 4096 pixels, 0.25 m/px. JPEG display tiles 512 px; coarser levels combine four children with Lanczos downsampling. Tiles intersect the CAOP2025 boundary and may extend beyond it; the viewer clips images to the vector parish boundary. JPEG display encoding is lossy. Source native grid is not stretched or reprojected. No NIR/NDVI inference.
